items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: he'd holler out, "Carmen Miranda, how's your veranda?"

ctx.x: ...a cymbal that he had on a stick, with a hole in the snare drum. [COUGHS]

And he had things he would do while we were playing, you know. Like, he'd do them in rhythm. Like, he'd holler out real loud, all of a sudden he'd holler out, "Carmen Miranda, how's your veranda?" or some crazy thing like that, you know.

I walked in there to work one night at the Capri, and they were up there playing... The Spirits always started. And I showed up for work, and I walked in, and there weren't too many people there, there were a few people... And I noticed this old man sitting, with a dark...black suit on, white-haired, just sitting there at the table, this little bar table -- you know how they had those little tables in these clubs. And he was just sitting there, just enthralled. He was back a ways; he wasn't up close -- about
